Lawn Mowing & Care in the Blue Mountains

One-off or ongoing lawn mowing, edging and care — a tidy, healthy lawn without the weekend work.

Whether it's a regular cut or a once-off before you sell or rent, we mow, edge and tidy so your lawn always looks sharp.

We can set up a schedule that keeps on top of Mountains growth through the warmer months.

What’s included

  • Regular or one-off mowing
  • Edging and line trimming
  • Lawn tidy and clean-up
  • Schedules to suit you
  • Great for rentals and holiday homes
  • Clippings removed

Why Blue Mountains Landscapers

We build for Mountains conditions every day — slope, sandstone, cold and bushfire zones. You get one accountable local crew, a clear fixed quote, and work built to last. Right now every job comes with 20% off for spring and summer.
